verdict.rationale: Column publishes transaction/summary reports (CSV/JSON/Parquet) and monthly statements, and exposes raw wire message data and a unified transfer query endpoint, which could support reconciliation workflows — but there is no explicit documentation of a formal daily reconciliation process or attestation that the ledger matches the bank core, unlike a dedicated reconciliation guarantee. missing for 10: explicit daily reconciliation documentation/SLA, third-party audit or attestation of ledger-to-bank-core matching, and any post-Synapse-style contrast showing Column's guarantee against ledger drift.
